steps.content: This is a house that no one has visited for a long time. Withered creepers cling to its exterior like the decaying limbs of some giant beast.
The wooden front steps squeak shrilly under your feet, sending a few beetles flying out from between the gaps.
But as you watch them fly into the distance, you notice some fresh new leaves next to the withered vines.
You get inside the house. Once inside, you follow your memories of the cold, vast scenes from the game you recently played and come to the second floor.
Etti?
I'm here to pick you up.
There's no answer from inside the room.
You motion to your squad members not to make any rash moves. You knock politely on the door again, then push it open.
Inside, the Sinner who had spurred the dragons is sound asleep with her head resting on an old handmade book, as if a child tired out by playtime.
...Guess you need your beauty sleep.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Zzz... Zzz...

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: No... You can't break the rules...!

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: This world... this world is mine!
Yes yes, it's yours.
You sigh and use your shackles on her again, then leave her over to your squad mates to bring back to the MBCC.
Etti slept soundly in the Bureau for three days straight, as if making up for all the energy consumed from "creating a world."
But now that she's awake, you can put your plan into motion.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Yawn...
She stretched and looked around sleepily. When she finally realized her situation, she flashed you a lazy grin.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: This looks like an interrogation room. Am I under arrest? Are you going to interrogate me?

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: It's just a game world I wrecked, not the real one, right? That shouldn't get me in trouble, should it?

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Besides, you're the one who destroyed that world, O Chosen One.

options: I'm not the Chosen One here.

choices.text: I'm not the Chosen One here.

steps.content: Here, I'm just a regular...

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: I know. You're the so-called "Chief" who wants to interrogate us naughty... "Sinners."
Since you understand what's going on here, I need you to tell me everything about Aesthia.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Tell you everything?

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Didn't you clear all the levels? Shouldn't you know everything already?
As the creator of Aesthia, you controlled everything about it.
Obviously, you can make edits unbeknownst to the "player."
Come on. Tell me everything you have done.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: What do you want me to say? I don't know what the point of your question is.
Hmph. Seems like you still have a bit of that dragonesque wariness... But no matter. We're quite tolerant here. We understand.
Etti looks at you, frowning.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Stop acting like you understand me...
Etti stares at you in disbelief. She is wondering: how can this person be so different from the Chosen One I met on the Isle of Sky?

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: I created a grand, happy game, that's all.
Yes, it is a great game.
But you went against players' wishes and forcibly changed "parameters," "settings," and even "fate"...

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: I was the game master. Like you said, I controlled everything in the game to begin with.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: I got to decide the development of the game. Victory and defeat are just...

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Results of the players' struggles in my palm.
Hehe, seems like you're finally telling the truth?
Since you control everything, and value that control so much...
I can already guess what you've done. I'll give you a chance to confess on your own. I'll be lenient if you cooperate.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Hmph, is this what an interrogation is like in your world? How tedious and boring. That's why I hate the rules here.
But since they're the rules, you must follow them. Now, tell me everything you've done...
You hid the lost treasure of this world, didn't you? To put our world under your control, too?

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: I hid a lost treasure? Huh? What are you talking about? What kind of treasures could you possible have here...
Still playing dumb?
You tossed the notebook in your hand at Etti, who caught it defensively.
Last chance. If you don't want to talk, write it down! You must answer everything clearly and truthfully.
Otherwise, you'll be locked here forever with no chance of getting out!
You bolt up, knock aside your chair and leave, leaving a baffled Etti alone inside the locked interrogation room.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: So weird! He wasn't like that before!
steps.female_content: So weird! She wasn't like that before!

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: What can a mere Chosen One do outside of the world I created...?
Etti flipped open the notebook in her hand, only to find it brimming with familiar categories: name, race, occupation, weapon...

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Isn't this a character profile?
After a few glances, Etti immediately understands what this is—a blank character card, and an invitation to a new game.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Ha, so this is your plan? Interesting, very interesting...

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Then let's see... what kind of game you want to play!
After waiting outside the door for a while, you hear Etti calling you from inside.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Hey, I'm done writing!

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Here, take a look?
You try your best to maintain a stern expression as you take the notebook and read it carefully.
"Hmph, you spilled a few secrets, but not enough."
"You still have a long way to go to make up for your sins. Get ready!"

"Since time immemorial, crime and darkness have shrouded this land."
"The people longed for peace and light, so they kept praying to the saints."
"The saints finally brought them hope—a magic box that can dispel darkness. Only adventurers with hope, courage, wisdom and kindness in their hearts can open it."
"Every adventurer sought to obtain this magic box, but it vanished without a trace..."
"Rumor has it that a giant dragon beyond the world devoured the magic box and hid it in an unknown place..."

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: What kind of backstory is this? If it's not something shiny, dragons won't be interested in it...
"Etti the Mage, the misunderstood messenger of the dragons, decides to search for the lost magic box to clear her name."
"Dear child, though now you're in prison and overcome by loneliness, please know that neither fate nor failure can ever trap the free dragon."
"Go forward towards your fate. You shall obtain everything you want, as well as things you've never imagined."
"Find the lost castle, get the magic box, and dispel the darkness. Once you achieve that, light, hope and a treasure big enough to fill your heart shall appear before you."
"Remember, my dear child, go in the direction that fate leads you."
You smile and imitate Etti's posture, resting your chin on crossed hands to look at her.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Interesting. Very interesting.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: I guess I'll just have to play along with your game. Try to impress me.
Etti twirled the pen in her hand a couple of times, then slammed it down onto the table.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: I haven't joined in a game as a player for a long time.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Hope I'm not rusty with the rules.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: I also hope...
Etti flashed her eyebrows and smiled at you.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: ...That I'm not too much for you to handle.
You take out a pair of black gemstone dice speckled with glittering dots, which resembles the starry sky over snowy fields.
After rolling for a while, those 20-sided dice stopped at the numbers 5 and 12 respectively.
"Guided by the God of Fate, you, Etti, the messenger of the dragons and a human mage, shall go two kilometers southwest to start your adventure."

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: ... Shouldn't I be the one to roll the dice? How come you did it?
"I am the gamemaster of this world, and you must obey my rules. I'm the dice roller because I say so."
Seeing you imitate her tone, Etti pursed her lips and snorted, but accepted it nonetheless.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: All right, but before I set out, let me cast the lucky dice.
What do you want to do?

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Aside from you, there are still a lot of NPCs here.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: I want to see if I can steal some equipment from them...
I guess you could try.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Really?
Etti's eyes lit up at the sight of you agreeing. She urged you to roll the dice.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: To ensure a successful outcome, I've decided to roll again!
Huh? You're going to waste your luck on this?
Wait, as a mage, you chose "luck" as your main skill?
Etti snorts in laughter, and repeats what you said before.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Neither fate nor failure can ever trap the free dragon...

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: It'd be boring to play by old-school rules... Not to mention, I usually control the rules of the world that I'm in.
The dice grind to a halt. Though the numbers that came up are only enough to grant Etti success for this one mission, it was a successful outcome nonetheless...
You nod and let Etti take away a staff member's sunglasses.
As you take Etti "southwest," you hear that staff member complaining softly.

steps.speaker: Staff Member
steps.content: Good thing she didn't want my pants...
